employee_contracts_pay_ck.name: employee_contracts_pay_ck
employee_contracts_pay_ck.value:
("employee_contracts"."pay_basis" = 'percent_of_line_haul' and "employee_contracts"."pay_percent_bp" is not null and "employee_contracts"."pay_percent_bp" between 1 and 10000 and "employee_contracts"."pay_rate_cents" is null)
      or ("employee_contracts"."pay_basis" <> 'percent_of_line_haul' and "employee_contracts"."pay_rate_cents" is not null and "employee_contracts"."pay_rate_cents" > 0 and "employee_contracts"."pay_percent_bp" is null)

trailers_location_ck.name: trailers_location_ck
trailers_location_ck.value:
("trailers"."location_kind" = 'yard' and "trailers"."location_facility_id" is not null)
        or ("trailers"."location_kind" = 'en_route' and "trailers"."location_route" is not null)
        or ("trailers"."location_kind" = 'city' and "trailers"."location_city" is not null and "trailers"."location_state" is not null)

dispatches_party_ck.name: dispatches_party_ck
dispatches_party_ck.value:
("dispatches"."driver_id" is null or "dispatches"."driver_name" is null) and ("dispatches"."truck_id" is null or "dispatches"."truck_number" is null)
        and ("dispatches"."trailer_id" is null or "dispatches"."trailer_number" is null)

load_stops_place_ck.name: load_stops_place_ck
load_stops_place_ck.value: "load_stops"."kind" = 'fuel' or ("load_stops"."city" is not null and "load_stops"."state" is not null)

load_stops_planned_ck.name: load_stops_planned_ck
load_stops_planned_ck.value:
("load_stops"."planned_start" is null and "load_stops"."planned_end" is null)
        or ("load_stops"."planned_start" is not null and "load_stops"."planned_end" is not null and "load_stops"."planned_end" > "load_stops"."planned_start")

loads_money_ck.name: loads_money_ck
loads_money_ck.value:
"loads"."line_haul_cents" >= 0 and "loads"."fuel_surcharge_cents" >= 0 and "loads"."accessorial_cents" >= 0
        and ("loads"."declared_value_cents" is null or "loads"."declared_value_cents" >= 0)
        and ("loads"."operating_cost_cents" is null or "loads"."operating_cost_cents" >= 0)

loads_pay_ck.name: loads_pay_ck
loads_pay_ck.value:
("loads"."driver_pay_cents" is null or "loads"."driver_pay_cents" > 0)
        and ("loads"."carrier_rate_cents" is null or "loads"."carrier_rate_cents" > 0)
        and ("loads"."driver_pay_cents" is null or "loads"."carrier_rate_cents" is null)

loads_quantities_ck.name: loads_quantities_ck
loads_quantities_ck.value:
("loads"."loaded_miles" is null or "loads"."loaded_miles" >= 0) and ("loads"."empty_miles" is null or "loads"."empty_miles" >= 0)
        and ("loads"."weight_lb" is null or "loads"."weight_lb" > 0) and ("loads"."pieces" is null or "loads"."pieces" >= 0)
        and ("loads"."handling_units" is null or "loads"."handling_units" > 0)
        and ("loads"."length_in" is null or "loads"."length_in" >= 0) and ("loads"."width_in" is null or "loads"."width_in" >= 0)
        and ("loads"."height_in" is null or "loads"."height_in" >= 0)

loads_ltl_ck.name: loads_ltl_ck
loads_ltl_ck.value: "loads"."mode" is distinct from 'ltl' or ("loads"."freight_class" is not null and "loads"."handling_units" is not null)

loads_complete_ck.name: loads_complete_ck
loads_complete_ck.value:
"loads"."archived_at" is not null
        or ("loads"."equipment_type" is not null and "loads"."commodity" is not null and "loads"."weight_lb" is not null)

invoices_due_ck.name: invoices_due_ck
invoices_due_ck.value: ("invoices"."issued_on" is null) = ("invoices"."due_on" is null) and ("invoices"."due_on" is null or "invoices"."due_on" >= "invoices"."issued_on")

settlement_items_amount_ck.name: settlement_items_amount_ck
settlement_items_amount_ck.value:
("settlement_items"."kind" = 'line_pay' and "settlement_items"."amount_cents" >= 0 and ("settlement_items"."miles" is null or "settlement_items"."miles" >= 0))
        or ("settlement_items"."kind" = 'deduction' and "settlement_items"."amount_cents" <= 0 and "settlement_items"."miles" is null and "settlement_items"."load_id" is null)

settlements_pay_ck.name: settlements_pay_ck
settlements_pay_ck.value:
("settlements"."pay_basis" = 'percent_of_line_haul' and "settlements"."pay_percent_bp" is not null and "settlements"."pay_percent_bp" between 1 and 10000 and "settlements"."pay_rate_cents" is null)
      or ("settlements"."pay_basis" <> 'percent_of_line_haul' and "settlements"."pay_rate_cents" is not null and "settlements"."pay_rate_cents" > 0 and "settlements"."pay_percent_bp" is null)

claims_claimant_ck.name: claims_claimant_ck
claims_claimant_ck.value:
("claims"."claimant_kind" = 'customer' and "claims"."claimant_customer_id" is not null and "claims"."claimant_facility_id" is null and "claims"."claimant_name" is null)
        or ("claims"."claimant_kind" = 'facility' and "claims"."claimant_facility_id" is not null and "claims"."claimant_customer_id" is null and "claims"."claimant_name" is null)
        or ("claims"."claimant_kind" = 'third_party' and "claims"."claimant_name" is not null and "claims"."claimant_customer_id" is null and "claims"."claimant_facility_id" is null)

planner_events_time_ck.name: planner_events_time_ck
planner_events_time_ck.value:
("planner_events"."start_time" is null and "planner_events"."end_time" is null)
        or ("planner_events"."start_time" is not null and "planner_events"."end_time" is not null and "planner_events"."end_time" > "planner_events"."start_time" and "planner_events"."end_date" is null)
